detail.longDescription: Monday I'm going to say out loud the thing I couldn't fit in 800 words this morning: that the 4:34 a.m. vote and the jobs report are not two stories. They're one story, and the timing of the first tells you exactly what they thought of the second. # Fediverse # SelfHosted # Owncast # Journalism # IndieMedia # QueerNews # TransRights # USPolitics # Podcast # Livestream 1/2
